Sandbox_InventoryTags_EnableCategories_t: Allow containers to use multiple inventory-category tags. Tagged containers accept only items matching at least one selected category. No selected categories means unrestricted.
Sandbox_InventoryTags_EnableSorting_tool: Show per-container display sorting controls for name, quantity, weight, and category.
Sandbox_InventoryTags_EnableAutoOrganize: Allow supported vanilla Packing recipes to be run automatically for the current container. Unpack/open recipes are never selected.
